import sys
from collections import defaultdict

def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read().split()
    index = 0
    t = int(input[index])
    index += 1
    results = []
    while t > 0:
        n = int(input[index])
        m = int(input[index + 1])
        index += 2
        friendships = defaultdict(set)
        for _ in range(m):
            a = int(input[index])
            b = int(input[index + 1])
            index += 2
            friendships[a].add(b)
        found = False
        for j in range(1, n):
            jury = set(range(1, n + 1)) - set([i for i in range(1, n + 1) if b in friendships[i]])
            if len(jury) == j:
                contestants = set(range(1, n + 1)) - jury
                if len(contestants) == n - j:
                    found = True
                    results.append("Yes")
                    results.append(f"{j} {n - j}")
                    results.append(" ".join(map(str, sorted(jury))))
                    results.append(" ".join(map(str, sorted(contestants))))
                    break
        if not found:
            results.append("No")
        t -= 1
    print("\n".join(results))

main()
